userReportedUpdateApiCostObservation.scope: The user's tested prospectus-update task; not all other SKUs or all financial-group sizes

notes: No price, person count, frequency or cost is backsolved from 60% profit.
All demand, task classification, purchase selection and repeat eligibility percentages are planning assumptions, not measured cohorts.
All projects enter the workspace. There is no blanket 35% project adoption filter.
The full-purchase list is an upper comparison, not observed personal spending.
11 updates are assumed one new main reporting period each. The old calendar did not specify periods; this assumption must be replaced.
96 initial question numbers are assumed 96 independent objectives only for this simulation. Real duplicates must merge.

The opportunity vector assumes different project/business-target/version scopes across rows. The source calendar does not establish cross-row independence; no real scope deduplication has been proven. Shared initial-draft/reply/revision analysis must be removed before actual forecasting.
10 old broad reviews are replaced with 10 financial-group reviews. The narrower scope cannot borrow old whole-prospectus token costs.
All 15 followup question units are treated as included original-scope work with zero new revenue. Their costs remain in the conditional other-variable budget.
SKU purchase fractions already reflect choosing manual/alternative work for that opportunity. No extra consumption-month or paid-month fraction is applied.
First-order vectors are taken out of the corresponding first-12-month selected SKU vector. The remaining selected vector is spread over 11 months; this is smoothing, not observed daily seasonality.

Second-year eligibility is separately redefined as being willing/able to consider the product for new work; it is not measured retention. Old 12-month paid-status numbers are only hypothetical values.

Other variable rate excludes separately modeled payment fees, VAT surcharge and quote evaluation cost; includes model attempts, OCR/tools, unrecoverable fulfillment/handling/rework costs, extra support, sales and marginal cloud beyond fixed budget. Refunded principal is already deducted from sales, never deducted again as cost.

The 0.8 per evaluation is an assumed incremental cash cost of parsing/scope APIs/tools outside fixed payroll and base cloud. It is not a second allocation of the 33100 fixed staff/cloud budget; actual cost is unknown.
Historical price snapshots and synthetic token geometry are not used to approve the cost rate.

Income tax is accrual with calendar-year loss carryforward, no historical losses, no five-year expiry within this horizon. Monthly reversals are not tax cash refunds. This is not a cash-flow forecast.
